newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks inch higher but kept in range by FOMC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks inch higher but kept in range by FOMC.

text.p: U.S. stocks adopted a positive tone on Monday but the prospect of a possible short-term interest rate increase at tomorrow's Federal Reserve meeting kept most investors watching quietly from the sidelines.

The Dow industrial average was up around 21 points or 0.29 percent at around 7216 points, after spending most of the morning shifting between positive and negative ground. Nasdaq rose nearly two points to 1342 and the S&P 500 Index was up.
Trade was quiet and cautious, with advancing issues on the New York Stock Exchange beating decliners by about 12 to 11.
